extractedText: Russian forces launched 756 attacks on Zaporizhzhia region, one injured Sunday, 19 April 2026, 07:43 An operational summary released by regional authorities reveals an intense wave of drone and artillery strikes across dozens of settlements. Officials warn residents to follow air raid alerts and safety measures as damage to infrastructure and homes continues to be recorded. As reported by the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration Ivan Fedorov in the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration’s Telegram channel. Over the day, Russian invaders carried out 756 strikes on 44 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region. As a result of the enemy attacks on Zaporizhzhia, one person was injured. This was reported by the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration, Ivan Fedorov, on Telegram, releasing an operational briefing. According to the regional administration, the enemy carried out 18 airstrikes on Balabynomu, Zarichnomu, Yurкivtsi, Lisnomu, Tavriyskomu, Nizhentsi, Lyubitskomu, Shevchenkivskomu, Trudovomu, Zirnytsi, Novoukrainske, Vozdvyzhivtsi, Kopany, Charivne, Mykilske and Verkhnii Ters. 552 unmanned aerial vehicles of various modifications (mostly FPV) delivered strikes on Zaporizhzhia and neighboring communities: Kushugumu, Bilienko, Stepnoe, Kalynivtsi, Lyubitskomu, Yasna Polyana, Yurкivtsi, Novoivanivtsi, Novo Yakovlivtsi, Matviyivtsi, Stepnohirsku, Stepovomu, Pavlivtsi, Prymorske, Lukyanivske, Orihiv, HulyaiPole, Zaliznychne, Shcherbakovu, NovoDanilivtsi, Novoandriivtsi, Mali Tokmachka, Charivne, Varvarivka, Dobropillya, Hulyai-Pilskomu, Staroukrainka, Olenokostantynivtsi, Sviatopetrivtsi and Tsvitkovomu. There were four shellings from rocket artillery on Zaporizhzhia, Mali Tokmachka and Charivne. Daily shelling chronology 182 artillery strikes fell on Novo Yakovlivka, Stepnohirsk, Stepove, Pavlivka, Prymorske, Lukyanivske, Orihiv, HulyaiPolе, Zaliznychne, Shcherbakove, NovoDanilivka, Novoandriivka, Mali Tokmachka, Charivne, Varvarivka, Dobropillya, Staroukrainka, Hulyai-Pilske and Sviatopetrivka. There were 98 reports of damage to infrastructure, housing and vehicles. Earlier local services noted that attacks on Zaporizhzhia’s infrastructure did not result in casualties. Residents are urged to follow the Air Alarm signal and safety rules during threats of shelling. If needed, monitor official local authorities’ announcements and observe safety measures during air alarms. You might be interested in: Russian forces launched 711 strikes across 35 Zaporizhzhia settlements in 24 hours, killing one woman and damaging homes and infrastructure, officials reported. Ukrainian military intelligence (GUR) reported a series of raids on the Zaporizhzhia front, destroying and clearing Russian positions; released video shows drones and intelligence-led strikes disrupting enemy logistics. The General Staff reported 41 attacks by Russian forces since morning, with the most intense assaults on the Pokrovsk axis. Ukrainian defenders repelled several attacks and held defensive lines.
